# Method SetActiveView

#### SetActiveView(DocumentId, int)

Sets the active graphic view of a document.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 7, 0, 0)]
void SetActiveView(DocumentId inDocumentId, int inViewId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the document to modify.  |  
 
|  int |  inViewId |  Identifier of the active graphic view of the document.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.7.
